_schema.note: Edit this file to add or update Podcast & Media entries. The site reads it automatically — no HTML editing needed. Delete this _schema block if you like; it's ignored by the site.

fields.id: Unique slug for the entry (lowercase, hyphens). Used only as a key.
fields.title: Episode / talk / article title, shown as the headline.
fields.type: One of: podcast, talk, keynote, video, article
fields.role: 'host' if Sonjoy is interviewing a guest on his own show, 'guest' if Sonjoy is the one being interviewed/featured elsewhere.
fields.show: Name of the podcast, publication, or event series.
fields.date: Month/year as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-07). Leave as null if unknown.
fields.guests: Array of guest objects for role:'host' entries: [{ name, title, company }]. Leave as [] for role:'guest' entries.
fields.thumbnail: Path to a thumbnail image, e.g. images/podcast-thumbnails/name.png. Leave null if none — all thumbnails should live in images/podcast-thumbnails/.
fields.links: Object with any of: spotify, apple, youtube, url (generic fallback link for articles/talks).
